project_name: LPK Integrated Digital Management System (Japan Vocational Training ERP)

japanese_nuance.accents: Subtle Crimson Accent lines (#DC2626), Clean Minimalist Spacing (Ma), Soft Asagi Indigo headers, Katakana/Kanji decorative badges (e.g., LPK 技能実習生管理システム / Integrated LPK System)
elements: Discrete red dot icon accent (#DC2626) on hero badge & institute identity
High density clean tables with neat borders reminiscent of Japanese organizational precision
Status Pipeline stepper bar with clean chevron dividers
Printable official Kwitansi (Receipt) with Japanese-Indonesian LPK stamp aesthetics

layout.type: Dashboard with Left Sidebar + Top Navbar
layout.sidebar: Collapsible desktop sidebar (260px expanded, 72px collapsed), fully drawer-based on mobile
layout.header: Sticky glassmorphism header with global search bar, role switcher dropdown, notifications popover, and current user avatar
layout.grid_strategy: High Density Dashboard Grid (Mode B): 4-column KPI row with trend indicators, 2:1 column main section split for charts vs recent activity/matching orders

components: Login form with email/password, demo account preset buttons for each role (Owner, Admin, Keuangan, HR, Guru, Marketing, Staff)
KPI stats cards (Total Siswa Aktif, Siswa Lulus Matching, Total Kas/Bank, Pending Visa)
Student Detail Profile Modal/Drawer with tabs: Biodata, Seleksi, Dokumen Checklist with status, Pembayaran & Tagihan, Absensi, Nilai Exam
Class list cards with Sensei (Teacher) info
Mobile-optimized quick attendance checker (Hadir, Izin, Sakit, Alpa)
Printable/Downloadable Kwitansi (Receipt) modal with LPK seal style
Income & Expense transaction table with filter
Staff roster table with role tag (Sensei, Admin, Finance, HR)
Candidate matching drawer (Filter student by N4 JLPT/NAT status, physical height/weight, skill level)
Activity Audit Trail log list with timestamp and role

testing.rule: Every interactive button, menu item, input field, filter toggle, tab, and row link MUST include explicit data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI uses Indonesian language for all terms (e.g., 'Calon Siswa', 'Pendaftaran', 'Kas & Bank', 'Kwitansi', 'Matching Job Order', 'Absensi Harian').
Implement full functionality with realistic seed data in React state or mock service so all tabs, filters, modals, role switches, and student pipeline steps work interactively.
Include a prominent Role Switcher in the top bar or header so the user can easily test as 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Keuangan', 'HR', 'Guru (Teacher)', 'Marketing', or 'Staff'.
Make the Absensi (Attendance) module extremely touch-friendly and responsive for mobile viewports, as teachers record attendance using smartphones.
Include printable Kwitansi (Payment Receipt) preview modal with printable layout styling.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on floating dropdowns or mobile navigation overlay. Always use bg-white/95 or backdrop-blur with solid fallback.
Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.slop_prevention: Avoid default generic centered card templates. Use structured Japanese minimalist grid layout, crisp 1px borders, subtle slate backgrounds, and clear high-density data presentation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use transition: all. Always specify transition-colors or transition-opacity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Use tight tracking on headers (tracking-tight), uppercase tracked labels for table subheaders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner for notifications located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx
